name: dot-halftone
title: Dot Halftone
description: Any image recreated as a field of dots on one canvas, sized by ink coverage, morphing between images with a radial implode and explode wave.
author: Harsh Singh <https://github.com/haaarshsingh>
docs:
Installed `DotHalftone` in `components/ui/`, plus the `render-loop` helper in `lib/`. Render `<DotHalftone src="/rocket.png" alt="A rocket drawn in dots" className="max-w-sm" />`; it is square and as wide as its container by default, so size it with `className`. Change `src` to play the morph.

The dots and the corner clusters draw 24 px outside the box and the dotted backdrop 40 px outside it, so leave room around it. Colors: `gradient` recolors the dots, `--dot-halftone-accent` the corner clusters and `--dot-halftone-grid` the dotted backdrop. Drawing pauses off screen and in hidden tabs; under reduced motion the dots appear without the morph.
